dedupe_keys.name: calrecycle material and waste characterization studies and tools

description: CalRecycle publishes the results of California's statewide material and waste characterisation studies and web tools built on them. The studies listing gives each study since the era of the California Integrated Waste Management Board, with reports and data; the tools estimate, for any jurisdiction, the tonnage and material composition of disposal, curbside recycling, organics and other diversion streams from 16 business groups and multi-family housing, construction and demolition debris composition, residential disposal composition by region, and disposal and diversion rates. The producer is the California Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery. Coverage is the State of California, with regional and jurisdiction estimates; the calculators rest on 2014 study data combined with local business counts. Access is free through the website with Excel export, under the State of California conditions of use; no open licence is named. Caveats: jurisdiction values are modelled from statewide samples, not measured locally, construction businesses are excluded from the business group tool, and study methods differ between years. Simulation uses: waste generation and composition inputs for collection, recycling and organics capacity planning, and estimates of debris composition for disaster waste planning. Related records: NYC DSNY waste characterisation (data-dsny-waste-characterization) and EPA Facts and Figures (data-epa-sustainable-materials-management-facts-and-figures).
